criteria.text: GET /agent-sessions/:id/children invokes the SDK children wrapper with the mapped sdk id and returns child session summaries (vitest spy + fixture); GET /agent-sessions/:id/children/:childSdkId/messages returns the child's structured messages (parts shape identical to M1-2's REST shape).
Tapping a task chip pushes a child transcript view showing the child's parts via the standard renderers (widget test with fixture).
The child view shows a breadcrumb '< parent-session-name'; tapping returns to the parent transcript at its prior scroll context (no rehydrate refetch of the parent).
The child view has no composer (read-only assert: composer widget absent).
Child sessions never appear in the sidebar session lists (controller test: children excluded from active/resumable lists).
While the child is streaming (subtask parts updating), the chip's status indicator updates in the parent transcript (existing ToolState path — regression assert).
ai-workflow checks --level pr exits 0; vitest + flutter test green.
criteria.reason: Full PR-level checks require running the complete test suite and build pipeline; validated at verification-gate stage.
